dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is this a fast computer?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ðɪs ə ˈfæst kəmˈpjuːtər?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And this chair? Is it soft?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðɪs ˈtʃɛr? ɪz ɪt ˈsɔːft?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. It's a very hard chair!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ɪts ə ˈvɛri ˈhɑːrd ˈtʃɛr!
